mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 49 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 51 under a waning crescent moon.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which provides a long-range vision for housing and transportation, and the city continues to maintain a strong Moody's Aa1 rating.

We have a full calendar starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and the Puppets in the Park event happening tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from October 3, officers arrested a 19-year-old Verona man after finding him in possession of a stolen firearm during a routine traffic stop for expired registration.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving the OREO Cookie Overload flavor of the day, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
